verificationLimit: Actual main.js handlers, frame, fixed ticks, vehicle HUD, enforcement, InputManager, GameUI, ControlsPanel, GaragePanel, Career, RoadNavigator, MapView, PhonePanel, LobbyPanel, VehiclePanel RaceUI and MultiplayerSession in a functional DOM. Race movement is a controlled boundary fixture; the separate race-v11 suite verifies real opponent movement, contact and full race completion. Component rows originate from real MechanicalSystem diagnostics. Engine ticks, service effects, routine AI, audio and renderer boundaries are tracked fixtures; the payload regression additionally uses real 36-car traffic and six-officer police snapshots. PeerJS transport is in-memory, records requested serialization and enforces the vendored JSON payload limit. Actual binary serializer/chunking is validated separately by peerjs-codec-v9-check.mjs. No browser layout, GPU, audio listening, physical gamepad, live signaling or ICE connectivity claim.
